items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: And occasionally Monk would call him, occasionally he’d play with Coleman Hawkins or he’d play with this person around the town, but he wasn’t happy.

ctx.x: We are filming in Scottsdale, Arizona at the Paradise Valley Jazz Party. My name is Monk Rowe and I am very, very pleased to have Sir Roland Hanna here as my guest.
It’s my pleasure, Monk. Thank you for inviting me.
Congratulations on this honor you’ve got here.
